content:
sarah.p: Quick sync — UniLab pilot wants to move from embed-v3 to embed-v4 (multilingual) next quarter. Need a proposal for pin/fallback matrix and launch gates. Primary constraints: latency should not exceed current p50 by >10%, embedding cosine similarity >= 0.98 on our cross-lingual eval set, and no API contract changes. Thoughts?

raj.k: Microbenchmarks: quantized v4 on A100 shows ~6-8% p50 uplift for short queries (<=64 tokens). p95 is spikier. We need to evaluate prefix/KV cache effect for our short-chat workloads.

emily_w: Thinking: soft-fallback strategy — default route to embed-v4, fallback to embed-v3 for tenants with strict latency or failing quality checks. Launch gates: bench pass on a canary cohort (5% UniLab + synthetic mixes), automated rollback triggers, and a 2-week monitoring window post-rollout.

lucy_cs: Customer asks for a 3-month grace path and an opt-in `strict-pin` to keep v3 for specific endpoints. Also asks whether we can provide migration credits if they opt-in to testing. UniLab needs predictable SLA during migration.

mike_ops: Ops perspective: we need catalog flags and rollout checks: `default_variant`, `fallback_variant`, `pin_ttl_days`, plus canary abort if latency_p95 increases >20% or quality_score drops >0.02. I can wire the checks into the rollout job.

raj.k: Proposed catalog snippet for the pilot (pseudoconfig):

```
catalog_pin:
  model: embed-v4-ml
  default_variant: embed-v4-ml-q4
  fallback_variant: embed-v3-legacy
  canary_fraction: 0.05
  metrics:
    quality_eval: crosslingual_cosine
    quality_threshold: 0.98
    latency_delta_p50: 0.10
    latency_delta_p95_abort: 0.20
```

emily_w: Two additional notes: 1) embed-v4 uses 1536 dims vs v3's 1024 — that's a breaking surface for customers. We need either a server-side compatibility shim (upsample/adapter) or a clear migration guide + client changes. 2) Add schema checks during onboarding so SDKs surface compatibility warnings.

raj.k: Feasible plan: for the pilot we can emit dual embeddings for requests (both v3 & v4) behind a `dual_embedding` flag for 6 weeks. Storage/compute cost estimate ~1.6-1.8x. That gives customers a deterministic mapping window and allows offline migration tests.

lucy_cs: :thumbsup: UniLab accepts a limited dual-embed window if we ship docs with mapping examples and a migration checklist. Will confirm credit ask after I talk to their procurement.

deploy-bot: Canary created: jobs/embeds/unilab-canary started at 1811112240. Monitoring hooks: embeddings-quality, latency-p50, latency-p95. Alerts wired to #incidents and #product.

sarah.p: Action items recap: 1) Raj add rollout checks + config to the canary job by EOD Fri. 2) Emily draft launch gates, rollback playbook, and customer comms. 3) Lucy confirm credit ask + strict-pin wording with UniLab. 4) Mike provide dual-embed cost estimate and ops window schedule. I'll collate and send the pilot proposal to UniLab once we have numbers. Thanks all!
